118:t_005:3.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「You're taking your sweet time introducing yourself...!」

118:t_005:4.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「That pretentious way of talking... I'd say he's an insufferable bastard.」

118:t_005:5.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Be careful. With that confidence... he seems to have a plan.」

118:t_005:6.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Heh heh heh... Your instincts work, at least, as befits small fry. But even if you know, there's nothing you can do.」

118:t_005:7.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Yes...! This is my trump card!」

118:t_006:0.en:
$$カツ$$
「You call that a trump card?! That's just an $$アンゲロイ$$!」

118:t_006:1.en:
$$刹那$$
「Don't act recklessly...! There's... something different about that one...!」

118:t_006:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I'm sensing a pure will to attack...! No, I should call it an impulse!」

118:t_006:3.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Is this some sort of sympathy between lower life-forms? You're quite right.」

118:t_006:4.en:
$$ギルター$$
「That $$アンゲロイ$$ is piloted by an $$インセクト$$... a soldier made from a modified insect of this planet.」

118:t_006:6.en:
$n
「You turned insects' aggression and ability to act as a unit into weapons...!」

118:t_006:7.en:
$$スズネ$$
「That man... Apparently he doesn't know that even the smallest insect has a soul.」

118:t_006:8.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Go, $$インセクト$$s! Target their battleships... the blue one first!」

118:t_006:9.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「Does he mean the $$トレミー$$?!」

118:t_006:10.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Destroy the mothership and the battle is decided. I'll teach you the basics of tactics.」

118:t_006:11.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「You seem quite confident in your strategic skills.」

118:t_006:12.en:
$$オットー$$
「All units, you heard him! Destroy every enemy that approaches the $$プトレマイオス$$!」

118:t_006:13.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Don't let your guard down. Those insect soldiers specialize in attacks and will charge without a thought for their own lives.」

118:t_006:15.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「Yeah, I know...! Leave that to me!」

118:t_007:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Struggle all you like...! You're already inside the trap I laid for you!」

118:t_007:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Now! I'll put the finishing touch on it!」

118:t_007:2.en:
$$フェルト$$
「I'm detecting contacts overhead! They're enemy machines!」

118:t_008:0.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「At this rate, we'll be surrounded!」

118:t_009:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Fools! A battleship isn't fast enough to shake off the $$インセクト$$s!」

118:t_010:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「$$インセクト$$s, attack all at once!」

118:t_011:2.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「Hey, Commander! Act smart all you like, but if you can't even gauge your enemy's strength, you'll never beat our tactical forecaster!」

118:t_011:3.en:
$$ギルター$$
「S-Shut up! I doubt a boost like that can last forever!」

118:t_011:4.en:
$$ギルター$$
「When it runs out, that will be your...!」

118:t_011:5.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「This will end before that happens.」

118:t_014:1.en:
$$グラハム$$
「This is $$プリベンター・ライトニング$$. I will now provide support to $c.」

118:t_014:2.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Sorry to keep you waiting, everyone! Starting today, we're fighting alongside you!」

118:t_014:4.en:
$$ギルター$$
「N-No way...! That woman... Did she plan this far ahead and lure the $$インセクト$$s in?!」

118:t_014:5.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「$$ギルター・ベローネ$$... You weren't the only one who had a trump card ready.」

118:t_014:6.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「You push your enemy into the worst possible situation while preparing for your own worst case... You seem to have forgotten the basics of tactics.」

118:t_014:7.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Shut up! I don't need a plan now! I'll overwhelm you with force!」

118:t_014:8.en:
$n
「That's hardly what I'd expect from a guy who was bragging about his strategic skills.」

118:t_014:9.en:
$$バナージ$$
「If they've run out of plans, we'll break through them head-on...!」

118:t_014:10.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「I'm counting on you, $$ライトニング$$. And on you too, Lieutenant $$パトリック#colasour$$.」

118:t_014:11.en:
$$グラハム$$
「That is why I came here.」

118:t_014:12.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「We'll show you, $$サイデリアル$$! There are still countless people on Earth who haven't given up!」

118:t_014:13.en:
$$スメラギ$$

118:t_015:0.en:
